newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Luxembourg's Juncker says EMU decision up to Sweden.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg's Juncker says EMU decision up to Sweden.

text.p: Luxembourg Prime Minister Jean Claude Juncker said on Tuesday he would welcome Swedish membership in a European monetary union but stressed that the decision was up to Sweden.
"We do think that it is up to the Swedish people, to the Swedish parliament and to the Swedish government to make the decision on their own," Juncker told a news conference.
"And we don't want to give lessons to the Swedish people," Juncker said after a meeting with Swedish Prime Minister Goran Persson.
Persson said he had explained Sweden's situation concerning monetary union and he welcomed Juncker's remarks.

The issue is sensitive as Sweden insists that it will decide in the autumn on whether to join a single currency. But many argue that the country is not in the same position as Britain and Denmark, both of which have negotiated the option of staying outside monetary union.
Juncker also said he was convinced that there will be a "significant" group of member states which will qualify for the launch of the common currency.
